insurer: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited
sumInsured: Not specified (as per Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table)

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: Once in the Policy Year, We shall provide for a reload of the Sum Insured... Reload of Sum Insured shall be available only once during a Policy Year... (iii) The reload of Sum Insured shall be available only for subsequent claims and not in relation to any Illness/ Injury (including its complications) for which a claim has been admitted for the Insured Person during that Policy Year.
great.reference: Section C.I.(h) Reload of Sum Insured
great.explanation: The Sum Insured is replenished once per policy year but only for new illnesses or injuries, not for the same condition already claimed. This gives you an extra buffer annually for unrelated health issues.

good.name: Initial Waiting
good.quote: 30-day waiting period (Code- Excl03) i. Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the ﬁrst policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Illnesses are not covered in the first 30 days except accidents, which is standard practice in health insurance. This protects you from immediate claims but allows accident coverage from day one.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the ﬁrst policy with Us.
good.explanation: Certain listed diseases and procedures are covered only after 24 months of continuous coverage, unless caused by an accident. This is a common waiting period for specific illnesses.

good.name: No Claim Bonus
good.quote: The accumulated No Claim Bonus shall not exceed 50% of the Sum Insured on the Renewed Policy. In the event of a claim impacting the eligibility of a No Claim Bonus, the accumulated No Claim Bonus shall be reduced by 10% of the Sum Insured at the commencement of subsequent Policy Year.
good.explanation: Your Sum Insured can increase by up to 50% if you remain claim-free, and if you do claim, the bonus reduces by only 10% instead of resetting to zero. This rewards you for staying healthy with a better bonus than many policies.

good.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.quote: We shall cover the Medical Expenses incurred for the Insured Person’s Domiciliary Hospitalization, up to the limits as speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table of this Policy
good.explanation: Home-based medical treatment is covered when hospital admission is not possible or bed unavailable, subject to conditions. This provides flexibility for treatment outside hospitals.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: We shall cover on a reimbursement basis, up to the Sum Insured for the number of days in accordance with the limit as speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table of this Policy, the Insured Person’s Pre-hospitalization Medical Expenses
good.explanation: Pre-hospitalization expenses are reimbursed up to a limit specified in your policy schedule. This helps cover medical costs before hospital admission, though exact days depend on your plan.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: We shall cover on a reimbursement basis, up to the Sum Insured for the number of days speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table of this Policy, the Insured Person’s Post-hospitalization Medical Expenses
good.explanation: Post-hospitalization expenses are reimbursed up to a limit stated in your policy schedule. This covers medical costs after discharge, with exact days varying by plan.

bad.name: Room Rent
bad.quote: Reasonable and Customary Charges for Room Rent... up to the limits as speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table of this Policy; ... If the Insured Person is admitted in a room category/limit that is higher than the one that is speciﬁed... then the Insured Person shall bear a rateable proportion of the total Associated Medical Expenses
bad.reference: Section C.I.(a) In-patient Hospitalization (Room rent) + Conditions (2)
bad.explanation: Room rent is capped as per your policy schedule, and if you choose a higher room category, you must pay a proportionate share of hospital expenses. This can increase your out-of-pocket costs.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: Non-Medical Expenses... as speciﬁed in the Annexure I - Non- Medical Expenses... List I - Items for which coverage is not available in the policy... 56 GLOVES ... 60 MASK ... 58 ANY KIT WITH NO DETAILS MENTIONED [DELIVERY KIT, ORTHOKIT, RECOVERY KIT, ETC]
bad.reference: Section D.II.(50) + Annexure I (Non-medical expenses list)
bad.explanation: Many common hospital consumables like gloves, masks, and kits are excluded from coverage, meaning you will have to pay for these items yourself during hospitalization.

bad.name: Restore Restriction
bad.quote: (ii) The reload of Sum Insured shall not apply to the ﬁrst claim in the Policy Year. (iii) The reload of Sum Insured shall be available only for subsequent claims and not in relation to any Illness/ Injury (including its complications) for which a claim has been admitted for the Insured Person during that Policy Year.
bad.reference: Section C.I.(h) Reload of Sum Insured
bad.explanation: The reload benefit does not apply to your first claim each year and cannot be used for the same illness or its complications within that year. This limits the usefulness of the restore feature.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: At the time of inception... if the Age... is 61 years or above... shall bear a Co-payment per claim... as speciﬁed in Product Beneﬁt Table/Policy Schedule.
bad.explanation: Co-payment applies mandatorily for those aged 61 and above, but the exact percentage is not stated here. You need to check your policy schedule for the specific co-pay amount.

unclear.name: PED Waiting
unclear.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED)... shall be excluded until the expiry of years / months as speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table of this Policy
unclear.explanation: The waiting period for pre-existing diseases is not specified in this excerpt and depends on your policy schedule. Confirm the exact duration before purchase.

unclear.name: Pre-hospitalization Days
unclear.quote: for the number of days in accordance with the limit as speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table of this Policy
unclear.explanation: Pre-hospitalization coverage exists but the exact number of days covered is not stated here and varies by plan. Check your policy schedule for details.

unclear.name: Post-hospitalization Days
unclear.quote: for the number of days speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table of this Policy
unclear.explanation: Post-hospitalization coverage exists but the exact number of days covered is not stated here and varies by plan. Check your policy schedule for details.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
